caption:
A heartbreaking revelation from the cricket field: Woman cricketer Ishma opens up about her suicide attempt.

Bangladeshi woman cricketer Ishma has revealed that she attempted to take her own life.

Speaking about the incident, she stated that she has only just regained consciousness today.

The revelation has sparked concern regarding the mental health and well-being of athletes in the sporting community.

headline: Govt plans to distribute new books in December after exams
summary: Education Minister says the government aims to provide students with updated textbooks following the completion of their examinations.
details: The Bangladesh government intends to distribute new textbooks to students in December, following the conclusion of their exams.
This announcement was made by the Education Minister, who emphasized the government's commitment to ensuring students have the necessary materials for the next academic session.
The timing is designed to ensure that students can transition smoothly into their new grade levels after their current assessments are finished.
caption:
New textbooks are coming this December!

The Bangladesh government intends to distribute new textbooks to students in December, following the conclusion of their exams.

This announcement was made by the Education Minister, who emphasized the government's commitment to ensuring students have the necessary materials for the next academic session.

The timing is designed to ensure that students can transition smoothly into their new grade levels after their current assessments are finished.

#Bangladesh #Education #Textbooks #StudentNews

Source: Somoy News, Jamuna TV
tweet: The government plans to distribute new textbooks to students in December after their exams, according to the Education Minister. #Bangladesh #Education #Textbooks
